#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

class AK375 {
public:
    string ak375(int n, const string& str) {
        vector<string> arrstr2;
        string tmpstr1, tmpstr2;
        int res1 = 0, res2 = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (str[i] == '(') {
                tmpstr2 += "_";
                i++;
                while (i < n && str[i] != ')') {
                    tmpstr2 += str[i];
                    i++;
                }
            } else if (str[i] == ')') {
                tmpstr1 += "_";
            } else {
                tmpstr1 += str[i];
            }
        }

        // Split tmpstr2 by '_'
        stringstream ss2(tmpstr2);
        string token;
        while (getline(ss2, token, '_')) {
            if (!token.empty()) {
                arrstr2.push_back(token);
            }
        }
        res2 = arrstr2.size();

        // Split tmpstr1 by '_'
        stringstream ss1(tmpstr1);
        vector<string> arrstr1;
        while (getline(ss1, token, '_')) {
            arrstr1.push_back(token);
        }

        for (const auto& s : arrstr1) {
            if (s.length() > res1) {
                res1 = s.length();
            }
        }

        return to_string(res1) + " " + to_string(res2);
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    AK375 solver;
    int n;
    string str;
    while (cin >> n >> str) {
        cout << solver.ak375(n, str) << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
